name: Ransomware
description: Encryption in progress or suspected: isolate first, collect evidence, find patient zero.
author: kubesoc
summary:
First alert:
Affected hosts:
Ransom note / extension:
Shares affected:
Backups verified:

tasks.title: Isolate every affected endpoint
tasks.description: Tag each asset velociraptor:contain:isolate and get the approval task signed off. The endpoint keeps talking to Velociraptor only (IsolationAllowlist), so evidence can still be collected. Un-isolate later with velociraptor:contain:unisolate, which needs its own approval.

tasks.title: Kill the encryptor
tasks.description: Add the process executable SHA-256 as an IOC, then tag the asset velociraptor:contain:kill. Approve. The flow reports every process it killed onto this timeline.

tasks.title: Memory image of patient zero
tasks.description: Tag velociraptor:contain:memory (Windows: Windows.Memory.Acquisition, Linux: AVML). Approve. The image's SHA-256 is written on this case as chain of custody.

tasks.title: Triage collection on every affected host
tasks.description: Tag velociraptor:contain:triage. Compare the timelines to find the first encrypted file and the initial access.

tasks.title: Check backups before anything is restored
tasks.description: Verify that backups predate the compromise and are not reachable from the compromised credentials. Record who verified and when.

tasks.title: Scope the blast radius
tasks.description: Which shares, which service accounts, which domain privileges. Add every host that the encryptor could reach as an asset.

tasks.title: Decide on notification
tasks.description: Personal data involved? Note the regulatory clock (GDPR: 72 hours from awareness) and who decided what.

tasks.title: Rebuild and un-isolate
tasks.description: Rebuild from known-good media, rotate every credential the host held, then un-isolate with velociraptor:contain:unisolate.
